beats.text: Greek myth, Crete. You're one of fourteen young Athenians, sent as tribute to King Minos.

scene.src: commons:George Frederic Watts - The Minotaur - Google Art Project.jpg

beats.text: Tonight, they lock you inside the Labyrinth.
Daedalus built it so twisted that even he could barely find the way out.

scene.src: commons:Edward Burne-Jones - Tile Design - Theseus and the Minotaur in the Labyrinth - Google Art Project.jpg

beats.text: And somewhere in the dark lives the Minotaur, half man, half bull.

scene.src: commons:George Frederic Watts - The Minotaur - Google Art Project.jpg

beats.text: It feeds on the Athenians sent to Crete.
Your only hope walks beside you, the prince Theseus.

scene.src: commons:Giovanni Battista Cima da Conegliano - Theseus Killing the Minotaur - Google Art Project.jpg

beats.text: Princess Ariadne gave him a ball of thread. Tie it at the door, unroll it as you go.

scene.src: commons:Theseus en Ariadne Metamorfosen van Ovidius (serietitel), RP-P-OB-15.870.jpg

beats.text: Lose the thread, and you wander the dark until it finds you.
Would YOU survive? Type SURVIVE or DEAD.
